episodes.title: Love You Like a Sister
episodes.summary: NMFS agent Jackie Quiñones leads a fun, free-wheeling and booze-addled life, then she uncovers a dead body on the beach, and she is plunged into the center of a complicated and dangerous opioid ring investigation.

episodes.title: Severely Weatherbeaten
episodes.summary: After discovering a lead on Sherry's murder, Jackie becomes determined to solve the case. Junior finds himself trapped, and Ray connects with his CI in ways that are unprofessional.

episodes.title: Rebellion Dogs
episodes.summary: Jackie returns to rehab, but only to help further her investigation. Ray starts closing in on Osito at the same time he and Renee cross the line. Junior takes the first step to becoming a soldier.

episodes.title: B.F.O.
episodes.summary: Jackie finds out where Krista Collins is staying, but gets pulled back into her own life. Ray comes face to face with Osito. Junior tries to reconcile with Donna's family.

episodes.title: The Best You'll Feel All Day
episodes.summary: Jackie puts every potentially positive aspect of her current situation at risk as she goes on a bender, which comes to put Krista Collins in extreme danger; Junior finds himself looking for a different way to prove his qualities.

episodes.title: The White Whale
episodes.summary: Jackie and Junior find it difficult to deal with the traumatic aftermath of a recent event; Ray's investigation makes some positive progress that could expedite finding the answers; Ray is ready to support Renee when she needs it the most.

episodes.title: Everybody's Got a Cousin in Miami
episodes.summary: Jackie asks Ray and the rest of the CCINU to find Junior after she learns he played a role in Sherry's murder, but she must do so before Frankie calls for his death; Renee comes to ask serious questions about her and Ray's burgeoning relationship.

episodes.title: #Blessed
episodes.summary: Jackie and Ray try to return to business as usual after a depressing failure, only to learn the case might not be closed.

episodes.title: Great White
episodes.summary: Jackie is white-hot to prove herself as a cop and avenge the death of her best friend, Junior. Frankie teams up with ex-con, cousin Jorge while Ray's off the force because of Renee's betrayal. There's a new deadly drug in trade during off-season Cape Cod, labeled "Great White."

episodes.title: Girl Power
episodes.summary: Jackie's new partner Leslie matches her ambition perfectly as their relationship deepens on and off the force. Frankie and Jorge continue to move forward but Charmaine, their New York connection, is a wild card. Jorge sows distrust between Frankie and Renee; as Alan turns to Frankie's old right-hand man, Ostio, to solve a case.

episodes.title: Fresh as a Daisy
episodes.summary: Jackie abandons her stakeout for a firey confrontation. Ray is once again humilitated, and does what he can to get back on the force.

episodes.title: Daddy Issues
episodes.summary: Jackie and Leslie get deeper into the case, and with each other. Someone will make a decision they will regret.

episodes.title: Dot Dot Dot
episodes.summary: Jackie and Ray both realize a distressing truth. Frankie feels threatened and Renee proves herself to be ruthless.

episodes.title: Behind Every Skirt is a Slip
episodes.summary: It's the day before Thanksgiving on the Cape: things are looking up for Ray, and looking grim for Jackie. Frankie is filled with anxiety over his business with Jorge.

episodes.title: Crack is Wack
episodes.summary: It's Thanksgiving but the drugs and despair don't let up. Frankie, riding an ocean of anxiety, takes Renee to the point of no return. Ray is going all in on a case no one wants him on, and Alan's holiday dinner is interrupted.

episodes.title: Houston, We Have a Problem
episodes.summary: Ray is so close to getting everything he's wanted, but he will have to maneuver things just right. Jackie's met with a crossroad and must choose how to move forward.

episodes.title: Small Craft Warning
episodes.summary: Renee risks everything to change her world around. Alan sets a trap that covers the entire Cape.

episodes.title: Fool Me Twice
episodes.summary: The whole "Great White" operation is cracked open, but a few mysteries remain. Ray's plan to get his job back has a complicated ending. Jackie goes from feeling like a hero after an important discovery to the zero who let something critical get away.

episodes.title: Good Times
episodes.summary: State cop Jackie Quiñones is back to her wild partying ways, Ray Abruzzi is top cop after taking down the New York connection, and imprisoned Frankie Cuevas secures a new partner on the outside.

episodes.title: I Said No, No, No
episodes.summary: Jackie fails a pee test and she is off the force - and it wasn't even her pee! Renee unwittingly lets Frankie back into her life and Osito defends his turf.

episodes.title: Fall Brook
episodes.summary: Tempers boil over and Ray and Alan explode at each other. Frankie learns valuable intel about Osito and Jackie learns there are even more missing or murdered prostitutes.

episodes.title: Jackpot
episodes.summary: Jackie lays out her missing prostitute's case and gets Alan's cooperation to go after Swayzee. From behind bars, Frankie orchestrates his greatest coup yet.

episodes.title: 29 Days Later
episodes.summary: Shane has a new partner; Ray and Renee's relationship hits rock bottom and Jackie completes rehab - no more rogue hero bullshit.

episodes.title: Chekhov's Gun
episodes.summary: Owen is more dangerous than ever and he's taking Sarah; Jackie closes in on the prostitutes' killer; Charmaine and Osito resume their partnership.

episodes.title: Big Fish
episodes.summary: Ray and Renee are backed against the wall and must make a deal with the devil. Shane's all-business approach brings sworn enemies together and a chance meeting helps Jackie pick a side in the coming battle.
